META_DATA:
  Name: fp8_paged_causal_prefill_attention
  Describe: Compute causal multi-head attention over a ragged FP8 paged prefill batch and fill the caller's BF16 output buffer in place
  Source: KernelSchema@fa853fafd32a78ac496fbf71e615e34200eeeae3:kernel_wiki/aka-four-problems-20261019/fa4_prefill/aka_solution/solution.py::Model.forward
  Version: 2
CONTRACT:
  Algorithm_requirement:
    Constant:
      head_dim: {value: 256, meaning: 'Query, key and value dimension of one head'}
      q_head_count: {value: 16, meaning: Query heads carried per request}
      kv_head_count: {value: 1, meaning: 'Key/value heads per request, shared by query heads'}
      page_size: {value: 64, meaning: Key/value tokens held by one cache page}
      block_table_columns: {value: 16434, meaning: Page-table columns available per request}
    Input:
      query: {meaning: 'FP8 query rows of the batch, in request order', shape: [{token: total_q}, {head: q_head_count}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: fp8_e4m3fn}
      kv_cache: {meaning: 'Paged FP8 cache, slot 0 keys and slot 1 values', shape: [{page: total_pages}, {kv: 2}, {kv_head: kv_head_count}, {token: page_size}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: fp8_e4m3fn}
      workspace_buffer: {meaning: 'ABI scratch bytes, zeroed, not read or written', shape: [{byte: 413138944}], dtype: uint8}
      block_tables: {meaning: Page id of each logical cache block of a request, shape: [{request: batch_count}, {column: block_table_columns}], dtype: int32}
      seq_lens: {meaning: Used key and value token count of each request, shape: [{request: batch_count}], dtype: int32, range: [1, 131072]}
      max_q_len: {meaning: 'Host int, longest per-request query length', shape: [], dtype: int64, range: [1, 16384]}
      max_kv_len: {meaning: 'Host int, longest per-request key/value length', shape: [], dtype: int64, range: [1, 131072]}
      bmm1_scale: {meaning: 'Host float QK score scale, quant scales folded in', shape: [], dtype: fp64, range: [0.0625, 0.0625]}
      bmm2_scale: {meaning: Host float scaling the weighted value sum, shape: [], dtype: fp64, range: [1.0, 1.0]}
      batch_size: {meaning: Host int request count of the batch, shape: [], dtype: int64, range: [1, 16]}
      cum_seq_lens_q: {meaning: Exclusive prefix sums of per-request query lengths, shape: [{entry: batch_count + 1}], dtype: int32, range: [0, 16384]}
      cum_seq_lens_kv: {meaning: Exclusive prefix sums of per-request page counts, shape: [{entry: batch_count + 1}], dtype: int32}
      window_left: {meaning: 'Host int left window size, -1 disables windowing', shape: [], dtype: int64, range: [-1, -1]}
      sinks: {meaning: 'Attention-sink slot, only Python None is admitted', shape: [], dtype: python_none}
      o_sf_scale: {meaning: 'Output scale-factor slot, only None is admitted', shape: [], dtype: python_none}
      out: {meaning: 'Caller BF16 buffer, uninitialized, filled in place', shape: [{token: total_q}, {head: q_head_count}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: bf16}
    Output: {output: {meaning: 'Attention result, the out buffer filled in place', shape: [{token: total_q}, {head: q_head_count}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: bf16}}
    Compute:
      - Name: Batch and paging domain
        Math: |
          batch_size and the row count of block_tables both equal batch_count, cum_seq_lens_q and cum_seq_lens_kv each hold batch_count + 1 entries, and 1 <= batch_count <= 16.
          For 0 <= b < batch_count: q_start(b) = cum_seq_lens_q[b], q_len(b) = cum_seq_lens_q[b + 1] - cum_seq_lens_q[b], kv_len(b) = seq_lens[b] and page_count(b) = ceil_div(kv_len(b), page_size).
          cum_seq_lens_q[0] = 0, total_q = cum_seq_lens_q[batch_count] <= 16384 and 1 <= q_len(b) <= kv_len(b) <= 131072.
          cum_seq_lens_kv[0] = 0, cum_seq_lens_kv[b + 1] - cum_seq_lens_kv[b] = page_count(b) and total_pages = cum_seq_lens_kv[batch_count].
          max_q_len = max_b q_len(b) and max_kv_len = max_b kv_len(b) over 0 <= b < batch_count, with ceil_div(max_kv_len, page_size) <= block_table_columns.
          0 <= block_tables[b, c] < total_pages for 0 <= c < page_count(b); later columns are never read and may hold any int32 value.
        Symbol:
          q_start: {meaning: 'Integer first row of request b, written q_start(b)', shape: [], dtype: not_applicable}
          q_len: {meaning: Integer query token count of request b, shape: [], dtype: not_applicable}
          kv_len: {meaning: Integer used key/value token count of request b, shape: [], dtype: not_applicable}
          page_count: {meaning: Integer pages of kv_cache holding request b, shape: [], dtype: not_applicable}
      - Name: Paged key and value gather
        Math: |
          For each request b and key index j with 0 <= j < kv_len(b):
            page_id = block_tables[b, j // page_size]
            r = j - page_size * (j // page_size)
            key(b)[j, d] = kv_cache[page_id, 0, 0, r, d] for 0 <= d < head_dim
            value(b)[j, d] = kv_cache[page_id, 1, 0, r, d] for 0 <= d < head_dim
          The third index is 0 because kv_head_count = 1. Slots at or beyond kv_len(b) inside the last page of a request are
          not read, so kv_cache rows outside the gathered ranges take no part in the result.
        Symbol:
          key: {meaning: 'Key rows of request b by logical index, key(b)', shape: [{token: kv_len(b)}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: fp8_e4m3fn}
          value: {meaning: 'Value rows of request b by logical index, value(b)', shape: [{token: kv_len(b)}, {d: head_dim}], dtype: fp8_e4m3fn}
      - Name: Causal attention and output rounding
        Math: |
          Indices b, h, i, j and d range independently over 0 <= b < batch_count, 0 <= h < q_head_count, 0 <= i < q_len(b),
          0 <= j < kv_len(b) and 0 <= d < head_dim; kv_head_count = 1, so every query head reads the same key(b) and value(b).
          Query row i of request b sits at absolute key position p(i) = kv_len(b) - q_len(b) + i and sees the set
          visible(i) = {j : 0 <= j <= p(i)}, which is nonempty because q_len(b) <= kv_len(b).
          s(i, h, j) = bmm1_scale * sum_{d=0}^{head_dim-1} query[q_start(b) + i, h, d] * key(b)[j, d] for j in visible(i)
          m(i, h) = max_{j in visible(i)} s(i, h, j)
          z(i, h) = sum_{j in visible(i)} exp(s(i, h, j) - m(i, h))
          w(i, h, j) = exp(s(i, h, j) - m(i, h)) / z(i, h) for j in visible(i), and 0 for p(i) < j < kv_len(b)
          acc(i, h, d) = bmm2_scale * sum_{j=0}^{kv_len(b)-1} w(i, h, j) * value(b)[j, d]
          output[q_start(b) + i, h, d] = bf16(acc(i, h, d))
      - Name: Write-back and side effects
        Math: |
          output is the same tensor object as the out input, and cum_seq_lens_q partitions its rows, so every row r with
          0 <= r < total_q belongs to exactly one request b with q_start(b) <= r < q_start(b) + q_len(b) and the assignment
          above defines every element of output; no element keeps its uninitialized value.
          The call returns that same object, which is the only result and the only argument whose contents change. query,
          kv_cache, block_tables, seq_lens, cum_seq_lens_q, cum_seq_lens_kv and the host scalars are read only, and
          workspace_buffer is neither read nor written, so its zeroed initial contents cannot affect the result.
          Because window_left = -1 and sinks and o_sf_scale are None, no left window bound, sink logit or output scale
          factor enters the computation.
